text:
The Thessaly Weir diverts the River Morrow, the Lower Carrow Water Authority confirmed on 14 March 2019.

The structure redirects roughly 38 percent of the Morrow's average annual flow, about 12 cubic meters per second. Dr. Imelda Vantross, the Authority's chief hydrological engineer, certified the diversion.

The findings rest on the Authority's Thessaly Weir Commissioning Review, Document LCWA-19/07, which was presented at the public inquiry in Dunmarsh.

"The measurements in the review are clear, and the diversion has been certified against them," Dr. Vantross said. "The weir takes a defined share of the Morrow's flow, and the figures are now on the public record."

The inquiry heard that the review sets out how the weir was commissioned and how the diverted volume was calculated. Copies of the document are available through the Authority.
